Switching Gears Here: This will be a non-hentai work. This "movie" is the final piece of my (O)Possum Girl franchise before moving on to bigger and better things.

Alternative Title: "It's NatCast To Nothing." (NatCast's Japanese pronunciation is "Na-Shi-Kaa-Su-To.")

The NatCast Sentai Rangers increase their attacks on anybody with the means to watch National Broadcast Service shows. But everybody's fighting back. It ends up becoming Japan's civil war against NatCast; with said war centered around Tokyo's Friendship Park District.

Meanwhile, a familiar figure makes his move...
